## Description and Rationale

One team member is studying Computer Science at the University of Portsmouth, the other team member is a cadet at Skyborne Airline Academy (UK) and a graduate computer scientist from the University of Portsmouth.

We decided to enter the challenge as we believe we can potentially produce a solution to the challenge using machine learning in Python and R as well as produce a decent report of said solution. We would like the opportunity to put our studies into action on a real life issue and produce a usable solution.
